meta.title: Morning Announcements
meta.textType: functional: spoken school announcements with dates and places

paragraphs: On Monday, October fifth, the pupils stood in lines on the school field. It was eight o'clock, and the sun was warm. This week, May read the weekly announcements into a microphone. Teacher Kim stood next to her. Lily stood in the second line with her notebook. The children were quiet, and they listened to her.

"Good morning, pupils, and here is the latest news for a new week," said May. "Are you ready for a new week?" "Yes!" shouted the pupils. "Today is Monday, October fifth." "The fire engine visits our school at half past ten." "Please come to the field at that time." "The school play is on Thursday, October eighth, at three o'clock in the theater." "Volleyball practice is on Wednesday at the lunch break." "Please bring your sports shoes." "The Explorers meet on Thursday at one o'clock in the school library." "There is no trip this weekend." "That is all for today." "See you soon!" Lily wrote the times in her notebook for the blog.

Then Lily looked at her notebook and asked Teacher Kim, "What time is the school play?" "It begins at three o'clock on Thursday," said Teacher Kim. "And what time do the Explorers meet?" asked Lily. "We meet at one o'clock," said Teacher Kim. "The play begins two hours after the club." Later, all the pupils came back to the field. At half past ten, the fire engine arrived. It was big and red, and it stopped on the field. A firefighter jumped down and said hello.

The firefighter was a man in a yellow jacket and a white helmet. "Hello, pupils," he said. "Today I will show you how the engine works." "If you hear a loud bell, walk to the gate." "Please stay behind the yellow line." The pupils looked at the long hose and the tall ladder. Lily smiled and wrote one more line in her notebook. "Today's news is good," she said. "The blog has a fire engine!"
